title: A built interior becomes a film
pitch: A sentence about a room in. A real-scale 3D interior, a planned camera move rendered through it, and a score out.
why: World Kit builds the room at real scale. LTX-2.5's layout-to-render LoRA turns Blender's grey clay pass into a finished shot along the same path, and ACE-Step scores it.
